Autumn-red leaves fill the frame on a dense crown of branches, and the leaves blend into a mass. Some lobes show at the edges, but no single leaf reads whole. The autumn colour makes the usual look false, and it is not a cause.

A large trunk with deep, interlaced furrows and ridges fills the frame, and the trunk edges and root flare are in view. The texture and pattern read clearly. The autumn trees behind do not change the bark.
Close view of rough, ridged and plated bark with lichen, lit evenly, so the ridges read clearly. No trunk edge, branch or scale shows, so too_close is true.

Two young, pale green tulip-tree leaves on a shoot, with a terminal bud between them. The lobed tips are small, so shape, margin and venation need close study, and the stalks join the shoot so arrangement is clear. No scale object, so size is no, and young leaves give usual_look false.
One ripe brown acorn hangs from a twig, whole in frame, with a shallow scaly cap, against a blurred green background. Kind, shape, hang and cap are all clear, with no cause.
Five brown acorns with caps lie apart on a plain grey background. Kind, shape and cap are clear; they lie on a surface, not on the twig, so hang is no.

Acorn cap and nut in three views on a plain blue background, with a 1 cm scale bar (ruler). One view is from the top or base, an unusual angle. Kind, shape and cap are clear; the fruit lies, so hang is no.

A tulip-tree crown with several open yellow-orange flowers among green leaves, viewed from below. This is a crown, so part is other and no photo features apply; the crown is cut at the frame edges, so whole is false.

A shoot with a green bud and several mature green tulip-tree leaves, overlapping. The large lower leaf shows a lobed outline but is cut by the frame edge, so whole is false; the crowding makes alone false and margin and veins need close study.

Acorn cap and nut in several views on a black background, with the cap seen from above, which is an unusual angle. The nut is whole and clearly shaped with its scaly cap, and the fruit is brown and ripe.
Green acorns sit on a twig among oak leaves with grass behind. They are full-size but not yet brown, so unripe and usual_look is false; the leaves around them make alone false.
Trunk fills the frame with vertical ridges and furrows, and the trunk edges show against green foliage on both sides, so too_close is false. Texture, pattern and colour are clear; mature bark.
A crown of yellow and green tulip-tree leaves seen from below against a pale sky, so the view is up into the crown and backlit. The leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf or fruit can be read.
A crown of green leaves with several orange tulip flowers in bloom. The flowers take the place of any leaf or fruit feature, and the crowded branches make this a flower and crown photo.
A mature trunk with interlacing ridges and fissures and grey-green lichen patches, in front of a city street. Trunk edges show on both sides, and the lichen does not hide the ridge pattern.

One whole, flat, green leaf seen from above on a plain dark background, with the four-lobed outline and notched tip, the entire margin, and the veins readable. No scale object and no twig are in the frame, so size and arrangement are not shown. The small reddish spots do not change the outline.

A whole green leaf with the notched four-lobed outline lying on fallen yellow leaves, which show the season is autumn. The outline, margin, and veins are readable, and the leaf itself is green and mature.

A shoot of mature green leaves with the lobed tulip outline on several overlapping leaves, and a small green bud at the centre. The leaves crowd each other and the background is busy, so the outline, edge, and veins need a search.
Two open orange tulip flowers and a bud on a branch among leaves, against a dark background. The flowers take the place of any leaf or fruit feature.
A crown of green leaves seen from below against a blue sky, with the leaves scattered at the edge of the crown. No single leaf reads clearly, and the view is up into the crown.
A close view of grey-brown bark with vertical ridges and furrows that fill the frame. There is no trunk edge, branch, or scale object, so it is too close. The ridge pattern repeats and reads clearly.

Several pale green leaves with deep, irregular lobes, growing low among ground plants and grass. The form is not the mature four-lobed outline, and the photo does not show the trunk or base, so it reads as sucker or juvenile growth, which is a reject.

Full tulip-tree trunk against sky and dark trees, with deep furrows and interlacing ridges that read clearly across the trunk width. Trunk edges show, so the frame is not texture only. No harder condition.
Close view of grey-brown bark with yellow-green lichen, showing deep vertical furrows and ridges. Texture only with no trunk edge, so too_close is true. Lichen is not a listed cause.

Tree seen from below, looking up into a dense green crown with the trunk at the bottom; the crown and trunk run off the frame. Part is other because the subject is the whole tree, so no part check applies and no reject code covers it. Owner should decide this one.
Trunk in woodland with pale lichen patches and vertical ridges; the trunk fills the frame with its edges visible at the sides. Texture and pattern read clearly and the light is even.

Two children stand beside a large trunk in a green forest, and the children are the main subject; part is other. The two children give the scale. No reject check covers part other, so reject is empty. Owner should decide this one.
Trunk seen against a lawn, a road, and a railing; the ridges and interlacing furrows read clearly across the trunk. The background is soft, so the trunk stays the main subject. No harder condition.
Trunk of a tall tree against blue sky and foliage, with deep vertical ridges and flaking plates that are clear at this size. No harder condition.
Extreme close view of raised, flaking bark plates with yellow-green lichen spots. Texture only with no trunk edge, so too_close is true; the plates and ridges read clearly and the photo is sharp.

Large trunk seen from the ground in a forest, with autumn leaves on the floor. At this size the ridges are faint, so texture and pattern need a search, and the lower trunk is in deep shade, which is the light cause.

Several bare winter trunks in a thicket. The central pale trunk shows vertical ridges, but at this size texture and pattern need a search, and the dark trunk on the right is in shadow, which is the light cause. Other trunks compete, so alone is false.

A whole dried brown cone on a short stalk, sharp against soft green foliage. The tapered outline is clear; the samara wings show only as overlapping scales, so kind is search. Dry brown fruit still on the tree suggests autumn.

A top view of a dried fruit whose seeds have dropped, leaving a radial star of brown bracts around a central spike, on a plain pale background. The view from above is the angle cause, and the outline reads only with close study.

A full-shape green fruit still on the tree, with its surface ridges visible against soft green leaves. It is unripe, so the usual look does not hold. Kind is search because the individual samaras are not shown.
A whole dried brown cone shown against a black background. The tapered outline is clear. The samara wings are fuzzy at this small size (252 px), so kind is search.
Two pale, open dried fruit heads on twigs, with autumn foliage behind. The spread carpels show the fruit has emptied. The two heads compete for the frame, so alone is false.
Frost-covered dried fruit heads on bare twigs, against a plain blue background. The subject is small in the frame, so kind and shape are search. Two heads sit close together, so alone is false.

A pale, closed cone lying on the ground among dry litter and a green clover leaf. The outline is clear; kind is search because the scales are the only surface detail. The litter and clover around it make alone false.
A brown, dry fruit with spread bracts on a stalk, with a blurred green leaf and autumn foliage behind. The outline is clear. The samara wings are read only with close study, so kind is search.
A single pale, open, papery fruit on a bare twig against a blue sky. The spread bracts show the seeds have gone. The outline is clear, and kind is search.

A tree crown seen from below against a pale overcast sky, with many small brown dried fruit clusters and some yellow leaves. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other. The view from below is the angle cause, and the bright sky behind the crown is backlight.
A dried, spent tulip-poplar cone in snow, with its carpels splayed open. The samaras have dropped, so the kind cannot be read, and the open form is not the typical closed cone.

A bare winter crown of a tulip poplar, shot from below against bright blue sky, with a few small dried fruit on the twigs. The crown runs off the frame, and the branches are dark against the bright sky.

Several sycamore leaves on a young shoot, flushing bronze and yellow-green against trees and sky. The leaves crowd each other, and the outline and teeth of each are small in the frame, so they need study.
A full-size, bright green sycamore leaf with clear lobes, coarse teeth, and veins, against soft grass. A second leaf sits at the top left, and the stalk joins the twig out of view.
A dense crown of a young sycamore filling the frame, its leaves blending into a mass against trees. Single outlines are hard to trace, and the margin teeth cannot be seen at this distance.
A mature green sycamore leaf with clear lobes and veins, with other leaves crowded beside it in dim shade. The margin is soft, and small brown spots on the leaf do not change the outline.

Two large sycamore leaves held in a hand against a mottled bark trunk, with lobes and veins clear. The margin teeth are small at this size, and the busy bark, arm, and fallen leaves make the photo less alone.
One large, bright green sycamore leaf with clear lobes, veins, and coarse teeth, against soft grass. Its stalk runs off the bottom of the frame, and no scale object shows the size.

A short branch of sycamore leaves, with the top left leaf showing clear lobes, teeth, and veins. Other leaves overlap it, and dark foliage fills the background, so the photo is not alone. A small green bud sits on the stalk.
A glossy sycamore leaf hanging in sun, with clear lobes and veins against soft dark foliage. Sun glare washes out part of the colour, and the lower lobe runs off the bottom of the frame.

Night flash shot of one mature sycamore leaf on a black background. The outline, lobe tips, coarse margin and main veins read clearly. Flash lighting is the light cause; the brown dead leaves at the top are other leaves on the twig.
A multi-stemmed mature sycamore in summer undergrowth. The top of the crown is cut off by the frame and shrubs fill the foreground. A large hollow at the trunk base is the damage cause.
One whole mature sycamore leaf on gravel with clear lobes, margin and veins. The stalk runs up to a twig at the top edge, so arrangement needs a search. No scale object is in the frame.
Bare winter crown photographed from below against blue sky, so the part is other, not bark. The top of the frame cuts the branches, and the view from below is the angle cause.

Several mature sycamore leaves on one twig, laid on white planks. The outlines, lobe tips, margin and the stalk joins to the twig are readable. The leaves overlap and the lower two are cut off by the frame, so no single leaf is whole.

A sycamore trunk base at a kerb, seen from a distance with parked cars and grass in the frame. The flaking pattern needs a search; the colour is clear. The trunk edge is in frame, so it is not too close.
A close view of mature sycamore bark with a branch crossing above. The flaking plates and grey-green colour show clearly, and both trunk edges are in frame.
Several bright green mature sycamore leaves crowd the frame, but the central leaf outline, lobes and coarse teeth are clear. The pale flower or bud cluster at the top is the sign that gives spring.

Trunk and a large limb of a mature sycamore, photographed looking up into the crown against blue sky. The bark pattern is clear, but the camera looks up into the crown, which is the bark_up_or_dark reject. The view from below is the angle cause.
Close-up of exfoliating olive and cream sycamore bark with rust-coloured inner patches. The plates are clear, but no trunk edge, branch or scale shows, so too_close is true.

A green, spiny seed ball on its stalk against a large green leaf, in direct sun; the whole fruit shows and its kind and outline read clearly. Green colour and full size give summer, and the fruit is not yet ripe, so usual_look is false.
Trunk base with root flare, seen from a few metres: the cream and grey flaking patches show, but the plate pattern needs a search. A red car and a kerb at the frame edge compete, so alone is false.
A bare winter crown photographed from below against plain blue sky; the crown is cut off by the frame. The main subject is a crown, so part is other and there are no key features to test.

A dry brown seed ball, whole, lying on a log in leaf litter, with a second smaller seed head with a papery bract behind it that competes for attention. It has fallen, so hang is no and growth_stage is after_seed_fall.
A tall trunk in woodland with curled, peeling plates readable across the trunk, and a soft background of bare trees. Bark looks the same all year, and the trunk edges show.

Bare winter branches with many small brown seed balls, photographed from below against plain blue sky. The main subject is the crown, not one fruit, so part is other and the crown is cut off by the frame.

A trunk shot from below, so the camera looks up into the crown with branches and leaves at the top of the frame. The pale bark shows only as patches, and the leaves in focus compete, so alone is false.
A whole brown, spiny seed ball hanging from its stalk against plain blue sky and bare branches. Its kind and outline read clearly, and the bare branches set the season as winter.
A close-up of grey bark with cream and yellow flaking plates and some turquoise lichen. No trunk edge, branch or scale object shows, so too_close is true. The plates and colour read clearly.
A trunk straight on, with cream and grey patches and a soft background of leaves. From this distance the flaking plates need a search, and the colour reads clearly.
Dried spiny seed ball after seed fall, whole and sharp against a soft grey background. The stalk runs out of the top of the frame, so hang is a search.
Several intact tan seed balls hang on thin stalks from bare winter twigs against a plain blue sky. The balls are small in the frame, so kind is a search; the round shape reads clearly.

Platanus x hispanica leaf, upper side, held by a hand on the left. The hand covers the left edge and the bottom lobe runs off the frame, so whole is false; the margin needs a close look at this size. The leaf is held at a slant. Small brown marks sit on the blade, but the outline is intact.

Green-brown seed ball hangs on a stalk from a reddish twig with a pale new bract, against soft green grass. The ball is full in shape but still green, so it is unripe; the pale new growth points to spring.
Yellow-green spiny seed ball on a short stalk, full size but still green, against autumn-coloured leaves. The stalk runs out of the top of the frame, so hang is a search.

Dried seed head that has shed most of its seeds: a dark central knob with a flared ring of pale hairs, on a stalk lying across a weathered log, seen from above. The round ball is gone, so the shape and the main part are missing, and the log grain behind competes.
Five intact brown seed balls hang on stalks from a bare winter branch against a plain blue sky. The balls are small in the frame, so kind is a search.
Green spiny seed ball on a long stalk from a bare twig with reddish buds, full in shape but unripe. The buds point to spring; the spiny form reads as fruit rather than a flower head.
Small green spiny seed ball hangs from a twig with pink buds against a soft grey background. Full shape and unripe, so the usual look is false.

A tree-lined avenue with a path and lawns, not one part of a tree, so the part is other and no features are answered. The scene is busy, so alone and whole are false. The leaves are full and green, so summer.

Several mature lobed plane leaves on one twig in front of a flaking trunk, so the subject is crowded and alone is false. The margin shows only as small teeth at this size, so it is search, and there is no scale object, so size is no.
One large lobed plane leaf held in a hand against the trunk, tilted in the frame, with the left lobe cut off by the frame edge. Lobes, margin teeth and veins are clear, and the hand gives the scale.
A crown of small leaves with a twig crossing it, the leaves blended into one mass, so the part is other (a crown) and the leaf_mass check applies. No single leaf outline can be read.
Close view of flaking plates on a trunk, with texture only and no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true. The plates, peeling and grey, brown and cream colour are clear.
A whole trunk with its edge in view and bright flaking plates of cream, brown and grey. The texture and pattern are clear, so the photo is not too close.
A mature lobed plane leaf held in a hand, showing a pale surface with raised veins that reads as the underside. The hand covers part of the lower lobe, so whole is false.
A brown, dead plane leaf lying on grass among other fallen leaves. It is a dead leaf, so the reject applies, while the lobed outline is still clear.

One green seed ball hanging from a stalk among leaves, with a car behind. The ball is small in the frame, so kind and shape are search. It is still green, so it is unripe, and there is only one ball on the stalk, so two_heads is no.
A street lined with plane trees, with cyclists, a bus and cars, so the main subject is a scene and the part is other. No checklist reject code fits a street scene, so reject is empty.
One mature lobed plane leaf on a dark background, with clear lobes, margin teeth and veins. A small green seed ball or bud sits at the lower left, outside the leaf, and there is no scale object.

A crown of plane leaves against blue sky, with seed balls hanging among the branches, so the part is other. The frame cuts off the crown and the photo looks up from below, so whole is false and angle applies. The crowded leaves make alone false.
A wide trunk with lichen and flaking plates, with the trunk edge visible at the right. The plates and surface read clearly in even, overcast light.
A close view of flaking plates in low warm sun, with deep shadows under the plates. It shows texture only, with no trunk edge, and the warm light shifts the colour, so colour is search.
The camera looks up from below into the bare branches against a grey, backlit sky, so the trunk is small and dim in the frame. The camera looks up into the crown, which is the reject.
A pale, flaking trunk that fills the frame, with both trunk edges visible. Palm fronds and a pot sit at the edges but do not compete, and the pattern reads clearly in even daylight.

Large lobed plane leaves overlap in the left of the frame, with a trunk at the right. The overlap hides the lobe tips and the small teeth, and the frame cuts off the top leaf, so shape and margin are search. The camera looks up at the canopy, so angle applies.
A mottled, flaking trunk filling the frame, with the left trunk edge visible. The soft green forest behind does not compete, and the plate pattern and colour read clearly.

A close view of dark, flaking bark in deep shade. The left side is lit enough to read the flakes, but the right side is dark, so pattern and colour are search. It shows texture only, with no trunk edge, and the frame is not too dark to read the texture.

A close view of flaking plates with no trunk edge. The yellow, lime and red-brown colours are far more saturated than plane bark usually looks, which suggests a heavy filter or tint, so escalate is quality. The plate pattern reads clearly.
A narrow trunk with flaking cream and brown plates, with both trunk edges visible. A plain white wall sits behind it, and the pattern repeats across the trunk and reads clearly.

A crown of green lobed leaves crowded so that they blend into one mass, so the leaf_mass reject applies; shape and margin read only with a search, so alone and whole are false. Set as leaf because the leaves are the subject, though the brief lists a crown under other.

A single green spiny seed ball of full round shape, held in a hand against a soft leafy background, so hang is no because it is held. It is not ripe yet, so usual_look is false; kind and outline read clearly.

A dried brown seed ball lying on concrete and seen from above, with loose seed hairs beside it, so the seeds have partly dispersed. The top view is the angle cause; kind and outline are clear, and the fruit does not hang on a twig.

One small green seed ball on a stalk among autumn-coloured leaves in warm low sun. The ball is small in the frame, so kind and shape are search; the warm light is the cause. The ball is still green, so it is unripe.
A single green spiny seed ball hanging from a stalk, with sharp lobed leaves on both sides competing for attention; kind, outline and hang read clearly. The ball is still green, so it is unripe.
A single green spiny seed ball hanging from a stalk against a soft dark-green background; kind, outline and hang read clearly. The ball is still green, so it is unripe.
Two brown spiny seed balls on one bare twig against a plain blue sky; both show clearly, so two_heads is clear. The balls are dry and intact, so ripe with usual_look true.

Several brown spiny seed balls hang on bare winter twigs against blue sky. The sharp ball at right shows kind, shape and hang clearly, while the others are out of focus and compete, so alone is false. No two balls share one stalk.

A small dark brown seed ball on a thin stalk among sunlit green lobed leaves, backlit. Its spiny surface is dark and small, so kind is search; the backlight is the cause. Shape is clear against the bright background.

Two green spiny seed balls on one stalk under a large sharp lobed leaf; both show clearly, so two_heads is clear. The balls are still green, so unripe, and the sharp leaves behind make the frame busy, so alone is false.

One intact, spiky brown seed ball held in a hand against fallen leaves; kind and shape read clearly. The hand holds the fruit so hang is no, and no second ball or stalk shows so two_heads is no. Source name matches the tree, so no mismatch.
